registered_note: Written before any RULA/REBA score was computed on any E4, X3 or M-series run. The X3 confirm and top-up analyses (kinematic and E) had not been run either.
question: Does a generation layer (conditioning, sampling, output correction) change the share of frames that are both physically reachable and not certainly at a REBA action level of 2 or higher
scope: Rule-based posture screening from OpenSim inverse kinematics of generated motions. No human validation yet (two blind raters scheduled); results are 'rule screening scores', not occupational risk assessments.

inputs.model: RajagopalLaiUhlrich2023, scaled per run by the E pipeline (model.osim in the run work directory)
inputs.coordinates: coordinates.mot: IK coordinates resampled to 100 Hz with a 6 Hz low-pass (biomech.write_coordinates)
inputs.dynamics: dynamics.npz: residual_force, contact_{r,l}_{heel,toe}; same 100 Hz time base
inputs.frames: trim 0.5 s at both ends as in E metrics; every third 100 Hz row (33.3 Hz)
inputs.markers: E marker set ends at the wrists and the neck base (no hand or head markers)

mapping.trunk_flexion_deg: OpenSim FK: angle of the trunk line (midpoint of the two hip joints to the registered neck-base marker neck_c) from ground vertical in the pelvis sagittal plane; forward lean positive (pelvis +X projected on the floor gives forward)
mapping.trunk_side_bent: 1 if the trunk line's lateral angle from vertical in the pelvis frontal plane exceeds the threshold
mapping.upper_arm_flexion_deg: arm_flex_{r,l}; at the model bound (>= 89.5 deg) both 90 and 91 deg are scored and their score sets united, because larger flexion is clipped by the model range
mapping.arm_abducted_or_rotated: 1 if abduction (-arm_add) exceeds the threshold, else 0; humeral rotation not scored
mapping.wrist_flexion_deg: unknown (no hand markers: wrist_flex is unconstrained in IK)
mapping.neck_flexion_deg, neck_twisted, neck_sid: unknown (no neck coordinate, no head marker)
mapping.leg_support_score (REBA): 1 if both feet have heel or toe contact, else {1,2}
mapping.legs_score (RULA): 1 if both feet have contact, else {1,2}
mapping.knee_flexion_deg (REBA): largest knee_angle among legs in contact (both legs if neither is in contact)
mapping.load_score, load_score_a/b, coupling_sco: 0 for object-free prompts (all X3 prompts; E4 ARDY, DART, CLoSD, PRIMAL, OmniControl, MotionLCM reach prompts); unknown for CHOIS and for Kimodo prompts naming an object (keyword rule below)
mapping.sides: left and right scored separately; per frame the worse side (larger lower bound, then larger upper bound) is kept

frame_classes.certain_risk: feasible and REBA lower bound >= 4 (action level 2 or higher whatever the unknown inputs)
frame_classes.indeterminate: feasible, lower bound <= 3 and upper bound >= 4

outcomes.primary: acceptable_lower: share of all trimmed frames that are feasible and have REBA lower bound <= 3 (feasible and not certain_risk); denominator all frames, so infeasible frames count against a run
co_reported: share of each of the four classes
median REBA lower and upper bound over feasible frames
sensitivity: conditional: certain_risk share among feasible frames only
ungated: REBA lower bound <= 3 share over all frames regardless of feasibility
neck from source geometry: neck flexion from the source motion's neck-to-head vector relative to its pelvis-to-neck axis, where the source has a head joint
RULA: the same classes and outcomes with lower bound >= 5 as risk (action level 3 or higher)

run_gate: E run valid (IK RMS <= 0.03 m, IK max <= 0.10 m, vertical force within 2%); X3 pairs also follow the amendment-2 wrapper FK gate
insensitivity_rule: If at least 90% of a method's C0 frames (pooled over its C0 runs) fall in one frame class, that method's ergo tests are reported as 'insensitive at this task class' whatever their p values

revisions.at: 2026-11-05T01:15+08:00, after a smoke test on 6 E4 runs and before any X3 or M-series ergonomic score
revisions.what: trunk_flexion_deg / trunk_side_bent: trunk line from the hip-joint midpoint to neck_c instead of the torso body +Y axis
revisions.why: the torso body axis is not the anatomical trunk line after per-run axial marker registration: on an ARDY walk it read 16.0 deg against 1.0 deg for the source hip-to-neck line; the hip-to-neck line in the model reads 1.2 / -3.1 / -3.1 deg against source 1.0 / -3.4 / -3.3 deg (ARDY, CLoSD, CHOIS); a Kimodo deep bend reads 56.2 against 49.5 deg (rigid torso beyond its range)

revisions.what: neck-from-source sensitivity: angle minus the skeleton's neutral-pose angle (per skeleton family: SMPL/SMPL-X, ARDY cskel27, SOMA77); reported as not available until the neutral offsets are computed
revisions.why: raw source neck angles on upright walks read 35 deg (ARDY) and 47 deg (CLoSD): the head joint's rest position relative to the neck differs between skeletons

revisions.at: 2026-11-05T10:00+08:00, after the X3 ergonomic results (confirm and top_up) were known
revisions.status: post hoc for X3, E4, E1 and the ARDY fair-target control; registered primary from X4 on
what: wrist excluded for every method: wrist flexion, deviation/twist and RULA wrist twist fixed at their minimum (a wrist-excluded RULA/REBA, not the standard instrument); standard scoring with an observed wrist is a sensitivity analysis for the skeletons with hand points (ARDY, Kimodo, CHOIS), not yet implemented

neck flexion and side bend from the source skeleton (neck-to-head against pelvis-to-neck) minus the rest-pose reading of that skeleton (config/ergo_neutral_offsets_20261105.json: SMPL for CLoSD, SMPL-X male for DART, SMPL-X neutral for PRIMAL, per-run rest pose rebuilt from the FK rotations for CHOIS, cskel27 for ARDY, SOMA77 for Kimodo); neck twist stays unknown. MotionLCM and OmniControl predict joint positions directly (no rigid skeleton, no verifiable zero): their neck is excluded (fixed at its minimum). shoulder raised when the clavicle-to-glenohumeral line rises more than 10 deg (约定，未经推演) above the same rest pose (excluded methods: not raised). Every run also gets a common version (r3_common: neck and shoulder fixed at their minimum for all methods); cross-method rankings use r3_common

repeated small-range actions (more than 4 per minute) fixed at 0 for every frame and method: a job-cycle property the clip does not define (one task execution in 3-20 s), treated like static_over_minute (约定，未经推演); upper-bound sensitivity reported

REBA legs and RULA legs: 1 when the pelvis moves horizontally at >= locomotion_speed_m_s (walking is listed with bilateral support in REBA), in a flight frame, or with both feet in contact; 2 with one foot in contact while not locomoting
REBA activity: rapid change or unstable base 1 in flight frames (no foot in contact) and 0 otherwise; inertial loads are handled by the feasibility gate (residual force), not by this item
revisions.why: with the registered mapping no frame of any X3 method was certain_acceptable and certain_risk was about 1%, so acceptable_lower equalled the feasible share; an attribution on five X3 C0 runs showed the unknown wrist, neck, legs and activity inputs held the REBA upper bound at 4-8; 5 of 8 methods (22-joint skeletons) have no hand points, so the wrist is excluded for all to keep observability equal across methods
conventions_not_derived: neck_extension_tolerance_deg 5: neck readings in [-5, 0) deg count as neutral, not extension
flight = neither heel nor toe landmark within the E1 contact margin
known_limitations: REBA trunk score 1 requires exactly 0 deg in ergonomics.py, so upright frames score trunk 2 (conservative, unchanged)
RULA upper bound stays high (muscle use, load, forearm across midline unknown); RULA remains secondary
verification: no axis mixing: the cross-product forward agrees with the toe direction in all 8 methods (cosine >= 0.96)

rest poses rendered (SMPL, SMPL-X, cskel27 and SOMA77 skins): upright, facing forward; the neck-to-head line reads 43 / 12 / 13.5 / 19-20.5 deg because the head joint sits low and forward in the skull
the SMPL-X regressor puts the head joint 2.5 cm to one side of the symmetric template mesh; its side-bend zero depends on the model (neutral -10.6, male -8.7, female -4.5 deg)
ARDY and Kimodo frames skinned with their native meshes: the zeroed readings (head forward about 22 deg, head tilts of 45 and 11 deg) match the rendered head posture
CHOIS joints are exact FK (parent-frame bone offsets constant to 3e-7 m); per-run zeros 13.6-14.0 / -9.5 to -9.8 deg

shoulder: clavicle-to-glenohumeral lengths match the zero skeletons for the 6 measured methods; MotionLCM and OmniControl 0.12 m (+20% against SMPL, within-clip variation up to 5.4%) are excluded; rest-pose arms are out, arms-down frames read 3-24 deg below zero, frames above the threshold are 0-4.8% and nearly all have the upper arm above 90 deg
revisions.x4_primary: REBA r3 certain_acceptable share within methods; REBA r3_common certain_acceptable share for cross-method rankings

user_decisions.wrist: excluded for all methods; observed-wrist REBA as sensitivity
user_decisions.neck: measured for 6 FK methods, excluded for MotionLCM/OmniControl, cross-method without neck
user_decisions.shoulder: measured from source (10 deg above rest)

conventions_not_derived.primary_uses_lower_bound: the upper bound is set mostly by the unobserved neck and wrist
